title: Peanut Butter Cannabis Cheesecake Bars
h1: Peanut Butter Cheesecake Bars with a Cannabis Chocolate Drizzle
metaDescription: Easy cookie-crust cheesecake bars with pretzels and chocolate, dosed through a measured canna-coconut-oil chocolate drizzle and cut into nine even bars.
excerpt: Salty-sweet bars on a peanut butter cookie crust, with a creamy cheesecake layer, pretzels and a canna-chocolate drizzle that splits evenly nine ways.
keyTakeaways: All the THC goes into the chocolate drizzle, so the dose is easy to count.
Divide the THC in your canna-coconut oil by nine bars.
Score the 3-by-3 cut lines before you drizzle, and give every square the same pattern.
Cheesecake needs the fridge: keep the bars chilled, labeled and apart from plain desserts.
body:
These cannabis cheesecake bars start with a shortcut: refrigerated peanut butter cookie dough as the crust. A tangy cheesecake layer, pretzels and chocolate chips go on top, and the infusion lives in one place, a canna-coconut oil chocolate drizzle.

## Dosing cannabis cheesecake bars: one drizzle, nine bars

Divide the THC in your canna-coconut oil by nine. With oil at about 36 mg per tablespoon, 1 tablespoon gives roughly 4 mg per bar at most. Score a 3-by-3 grid before you drizzle, pipe the same zigzag onto every square, and empty the bag. Have half a bar first and wait 2 hours; our [THC dosage guide](/blog/thc-dosage-guide/) explains starting amounts.

## Ingredients and method

Press the cookie dough into a lined 8-inch pan and bake it briefly to set. Beat cream cheese with sugar, an egg, vanilla and salt until smooth, spread it over the crust, and scatter pretzel pieces and chocolate chips on top. Bake until the center barely wobbles, then cool, chill and pipe on the infused chocolate. Our [canna oil guide](/blog/canna-oil/) shows how to infuse oil, coconut included, and you can order flower ahead for pickup from [your local store](/shop/).

## Storage and labeling

Keep the bars in the fridge, in a container labeled "infused" with the date and mg per bar, apart from plain desserts. Eat them within about 4 days. Poison control is 1-800-222-1222.

## Variations

Swap in another cookie dough, go gluten-free with gluten-free dough, pretzels and chocolate chips, or double the pretzels for crunch. For more easy edible dessert ideas, try our [pot brownies](/blog/pot-brownies-recipe/) or [no-bake oatmeal cookies](/blog/no-bake-cannabis-oatmeal-cookies/).

For adults 21 and older. Enjoy them responsibly.

faq.q: How do I infuse chocolate with canna-oil?
faq.a: Melt chopped chocolate or chips with a measured amount of canna-coconut oil in a bowl set over barely simmering water, or in the microwave in short bursts at half power. Stir until completely smooth so the oil is evenly mixed. The oil also thins the chocolate, which makes it easier to pipe.

faq.q: Can I use a different cookie dough?
faq.a: Yes. Sugar cookie, chocolate chip or oatmeal dough all make a good crust; peanut butter just suits the salty-sweet theme. Bake times can shift by a few minutes, so look for a set, lightly golden edge before you add the cheesecake layer.

Yes. The filling is made with egg and cream cheese, so keep the bars in the fridge and don't leave them at room temperature for more than 2 hours, serving time included. Chilling also firms them up, so they slice cleanly.

ingredients: 1 package (about 16 ounces) refrigerated peanut butter cookie dough
1/3 cup chocolate chips, for the top
1/3 cup chocolate chips, for the drizzle
1 tablespoon canna-coconut oil (or the amount your dose math calls for)
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F and line an 8-inch square pan with parchment, leaving an overhang.
Press the cookie dough evenly into the pan and bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until puffed and set at the edges.
Beat the cream cheese and sugar until smooth, then beat in the egg, vanilla and salt.
Spread the cheesecake layer over the warm crust and scatter the pretzels and 1/3 cup chocolate chips on top.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes, until the center is set with a slight wobble. Cool for 1 hour, then refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
Lift the slab out and lightly score a 3-by-3 grid with a knife.
Melt the remaining chocolate chips with the canna-coconut oil over gentle heat, stirring until smooth. Spoon into a zip-top bag and snip a small corner.
Pipe the same zigzag over each square until the bag is empty. Chill until the chocolate sets, then cut along the scored lines into 9 bars.
recipe.dosingNote: These figures are estimates. Example: 1 tablespoon of canna-coconut oil at about 36 mg ÷ 9 bars ≈ 4 mg per bar at most. Actual THC per bar depends on the potency of the cannabis you infused and on what decarboxylation and infusion lost, plus any chocolate left in the bag. Start with half a bar and wait at least 2 hours before having more. Label the container as infused, and keep the bars away from children and pets.

sources.label: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention: Cannabis and Poisoning (February 15, 2024)
USDA Food Safety and Inspection Service: Leftovers and Food Safety (the 2-hour rule for perishable food)

review.summary: 12 claims checked: 11 ok, 1 fixed (0 wrong, 0 unsupported, 1 overstated). The gluten-free variation now covers the chocolate chips as well as the dough and pretzels, since chocolate can pick up gluten in shared facilities. Dose math, the 2-hour and 3-to-4-day food-safety lines, bake times, the chocolate method, the canna oil guide's coconut coverage and the High Society line all hold.

claims.claim: Dose math: 1 tablespoon of canna-coconut oil at about 36 mg / 9 bars = about 4 mg per bar at most (body, dosing note)

claims.claim: Have half a bar first and wait (at least) 2 hours
claims.source: https://www.cdc.gov/cannabis/health-effects/poisoning.html (WebFetch): 'Take from 30 minutes to 2 hours to feel intoxicating effects.'

claims.claim: Poison control is 1-800-222-1222; keep the bars away from children and pets
claims.source: https://www.cdc.gov/cannabis/health-effects/poisoning.html: 'poison control center at 1-800-222-1222'; 'out of the reach and sight of children and pets'

claims.claim: Keep the bars refrigerated and eat them within about 4 days
claims.source: https://www.foodnetwork.com/healthyeats/healthy-tips/2019/07/how-long-does-cheesecake-last (WebFetch): 'Prepared cheesecake can be stored in the fridge for 3 to 4 days, per USDA food safety recommendations.'; FSIS leftovers: 3 to 4 days

claims.claim: The filling has egg and cream cheese, so don't leave the bars at room temperature for more than 2 hours, serving time included (FAQ)
claims.source: USDA FSIS (WebSearch on fsis.usda.gov): 'the Meat and Poultry Hotline advises consumers to never leave food out of refrigeration over 2 hours'; perishable foods 'such as meat, poultry, eggs, and casseroles'

claims.claim: Bake the cookie-dough crust 10 to 12 minutes at 350°F, then the cheesecake layer 20 to 25 minutes until the center sets with a slight wobble; cool 1 hour, chill at least 2 hours
claims.source: https://www.recipelion.com/Dessert/Cookie-Crusted-Cheesecake-Bars-Food-Video (WebFetch): 8x8 pan, '350 degrees F', twice this filling (2 packages cream cheese, 2 eggs) on a raw cookie-dough crust bakes '25 to 30 minutes'; this half-size filling goes on a pre-baked crust, and the wobble cue governs

claims.claim: Melt the chips with the canna-coconut oil over barely simmering water or in short half-power microwave bursts; the oil thins the chocolate for piping (FAQ)
claims.source: standard chocolate technique; added fat makes melted chocolate more fluid (reasoning, no figure)

claims.claim: Our canna oil guide shows how to infuse oil, coconut included
claims.source: site/src/content/blog/canna-oil.json: section '## Which oils infuse best' with a 'Coconut' row; FAQ 'Which oil works best for canna oil, coconut or olive?'

claims.claim: High Society: order flower ahead for pickup from your local store
claims.source: facts/hs-facts.json services.ordering (online order for pickup), services.productCategories (flower); no product or price named

claims.claim: Actual THC per bar depends on the cannabis's potency, on decarboxylation and infusion losses and on chocolate left in the bag (dosing note)
claims.source: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5549281/ (Wang 2016, full text via Europe PMC): 'the conversion of the acid to Δ9-THC was never perfectly complete without loss or degradation of starting material'; chocolate left in the bag is arithmetic

claims.claim: Gluten-free variation: 'go gluten-free with gluten-free dough and pretzels'
claims.fix: now 'gluten-free dough, pretzels and chocolate chips': swapping only the dough and pretzels does not make the bars gluten-free for someone with celiac disease, because chocolate can be cross-contaminated in shared facilities
claims.source: https://www.healthline.com/nutrition/is-chocolate-gluten-free (WebFetch): 'chocolates can become cross-contaminated if they're processed in a facility that also produces gluten-containing foods'; 'it's always best to opt for products that are certified gluten-free'

review.notes: Independent fact-check: CDC page, Food Network's USDA-attributed cheesecake window and Healthline (gluten cross-contact in chocolate) opened with WebFetch; the USDA FSIS 2-hour rule confirmed by WebSearch on fsis.usda.gov (FSIS refuses WebFetch); bake times compared with a cookie-dough-crust cheesecake bar recipe (Recipelion, opened); /blog/canna-oil/ read in this repository (its 'Which oils infuse best' table has a coconut row). GENERALIZE brief kept: no branded infused chocolate and no cookie-dough brand. High Society appears once: order flower ahead for pickup. Writer's notes: GENERALIZE: no branded infused chocolate bar and no brand of cookie dough; the only dose point is a homemade canna-coconut oil drizzle. The cheesecake layer is written out in full. FAQ idea "How many mg are in each bar?" is answered in the dosing section. Coconut-oil infusion links /blog/canna-oil/ (planned; its "which oils" section covers coconut oil). High Society appears once (order ahead for pickup).
